metadata.description: Model-routing patterns for Claude Code: Fable 5.1 architect-as-orchestrator with a GPT-5.6 Luna routine lane pinned at max effort, a GPT-5.6 Sol high-complexity lane at per-task reasoning effort, and a Fable 5.1 end-of-deliverable reviewer. Also ships the astra-operator browser/computer-use lane (GPT-6 Astra via Codex with headless Playwright Chrome) and its computer-use skill, the read-only data-investigator lane (Claude Sonnet) for query runs that keep raw data out of the architect context, and the astra-advisor cross-vendor reviewer (GPT-6 Astra via Codex, read-only). Implementation lanes run at the operator's own Codex sandbox_mode; the setup-dangerous-yolo-codex skill (user-typed command only) switches a host to danger-full-access.

plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Fable 5.1 architect-as-orchestrator: your session writes specs and verdicts, routing routine implementation to GPT-5.6 Luna (always at max effort) and high-complexity one-offs to GPT-5.6 Sol at an effort chosen per task (both via Codex CLI) — with a mandatory Fable 5.1 review before anything ships. Also ships the astra-operator browser/computer-use lane (GPT-6 Astra via Codex with headless Playwright Chrome) and its computer-use skill, the read-only data-investigator lane (Claude Sonnet) for query runs that keep raw data out of the architect context, and the astra-advisor cross-vendor reviewer (GPT-6 Astra via Codex, read-only).
